svg.title: 4K Omarchy frame achieved; Real guest GPU reaches QEMU SDL; two repeated 1800-frame two-window streams pass; intermittent reference failure and recovery open; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: Two fresh NVIDIA 621.01 guests exceed 2 GiB of virtual mappings before 56 GPU copy/evict cycles and 1800 desktop handoffs over 35.3 and 34.5 seconds, complete source/window pixel audits, input response and live cleanup. The CPU384 experiment passes two 1800-frame streams with two readable NVIDIA applications, complete pixels and live cleanup. An earlier 16-reference failure remains unresolved. The same binary preserves the legacy CPU192 agreement. All failed attempts remain retained. Physical scanout, input latency, full desktop, DLSS, hardware ray tracing and 93 percent matched-native performance remain unverified. Backend 4 of 8; desktop product 0 of 4. Updated October 23, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Latest: two-window repeats pass 1,800 handoffs, complete pixels and live cleanup
Explicit CPU384 opt-in · Earlier 16-reference failure and recovery remain open
Next: continuous multi-window stability, verified failure recovery and official physical input
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-23
Real guest GPU source: 3840×2160 · SDL backbuffer: 2560×1566 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
